schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.staffDescription: Upcoming trips. Open a departure to work through its roster, readiness, prep list, and manifest.
schedule.diverDescription: Find your next day on the water, see what to expect, and reserve your spot.
schedule.noTrips: No trips on the books yet
schedule.noTripsStaff: The board is clear. Schedule your first departure and divers can start booking.
schedule.noTripsPublic: Check back soon — or call the shop and we'll find you a boat.

trip.depositLine: {deposit} deposit at booking · {balance} balance at the dock
trip.shareText: Dive with me — here are the trip details.
trip.compareNote: Typical site facts, not a promise of the route, wildlife, or conditions on the day.
trip.briefingsFooter: Conditions and timing apply to the whole boat day. Sites can change, and the crew makes the final call at the dock.
trip.siteRouteAtDock: The crew will brief the final route at the dock.
trip.sitePlanningGuide: A planning guide, not a certification or safety clearance.
trip.siteWhatToLookFor: What to look for down there
trip.forecastCrewNote: Forecast supplied by the crew; conditions can change. The final call happens at the dock.
trip.forecastSourceSuffix: — the crew confirms conditions and makes the final call at the dock.
trip.forecastVisibilityNote: Underwater visibility comes from the crew.

timeline.boatRide: Boat ride and dives — crew confirms the live plan

trip.siteFitDemandingDetail: Depth or water movement can add work here. Read the site facts and check with the crew if it has been a while.
trip.siteFitWelcomingDetail: The published depth and water movement make this an approachable crew-led day.
trip.siteFitUnknownDetail: The crew adapts the route to the group and the day. The facts below are the useful starting point.

booking.heading: Grab a spot
booking.paidSecurely: {price} per diver — paid securely when you book.
booking.giftTitle: Giving this dive as a gift?
booking.giftBody: Enter the recipient's name and email below, then pay from this device. Their confirmation and ready-to-dive steps go straight to them.
booking.preferenceLabel: What kind of dive would make your day?
booking.preferenceHint: (optional — shared with the crew, never a promise)
booking.preferencePlaceholder: Macro photos, a relaxed pace, or staying with friends
booking.noAccountNeeded: No account needed. The shop will confirm your certification and rental fit when you arrive.
booking.waitlistBody: If a spot opens, the shop will have your details ready.
booking.waitlistConfirmedBody: A spot is not held yet. The shop can see your place in line and will contact you if one opens up.
booking.holdBody: See the conditions update above. Divers who already booked keep their seats and can follow it live here.
booking.confirmedDockCall: {date}, {time} — be at the dock {minutes} minutes early and we'll take it from there.
booking.goDeeperBody: This dive needs the next certification step. See how {course} gets you there — no pressure, just the path when you want it.
booking.allSet: You're all set — nothing left but to show up.
booking.paymentDepositBalance: Your seat's locked in. The {balance} balance is due at the dock.
booking.paymentSquare: You're square with the shop for this trip.
booking.paymentStillOpen: Your spot is safe — payment's still open
booking.paymentBody: Pay securely through the shop's own payment page. If you'd rather settle at the counter, that works too.
booking.shopTakesOver: You're booked — the shop takes it from here
booking.shopTakesOverBody: We're double-checking a couple of things on our side. Nothing you need to do right now.
booking.trackReadiness: Track everything on your readiness page →

lastMinute.heading: Want a deal on a last-minute spot?
lastMinute.body: Tell us when you're around and we'll email you if a boat needs to fill seats at a discount.
lastMinute.joinedBody: We'll email you if a discounted last-minute spot opens up in your dates.

course.hidden: Hidden — divers cannot see this page.
course.noDatesLead: No dates on the books right now — this course runs on request.
course.orGetInTouch: or get in touch and we will set one.

path.lastStep: This is the last step on {path} — after it, ask us where to go next.

reviews.verifiedNote: Every review here comes from a diver who was on the boat.
reviews.askBody: A rating takes a second. Words are welcome but never required.
reviews.commentPlaceholder: The crew, the sites, how the day ran
reviews.savedPending: Thanks — the shop will read your words before they go up.
reviews.savedError: That didn't save — pick a rating and try again.
reviews.aggregate: {average} out of 5 · {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}

recap.heading: Nice diving
recap.externalReviewBody: A public review helps other divers find {shop} — and means the world to the crew that took you out today.
recap.unavailableBody: Ask your dive shop for a fresh link — nothing here is private to anyone but you.
recap.photoAdded: Added to your recap — thanks for sharing!
recap.photoMissing: Pick a photo first, then add it.
recap.photoUnsupported: Photo uploads aren't set up for this shop yet — no worries, tag them when you post.
recap.photoFailed: That photo didn't upload — try a JPEG or PNG under 5 MB.
recap.tipCancelled: No worries — the tip wasn't charged.
recap.tipRange: Enter a tip amount between $1 and $500.
recap.tipFailed: That didn't go through — try again in a moment.
recap.photoLimit: That's the most photos one recap holds ({max}).
recap.loggedAt: You logged {count, plural, one {a dive} other {# dives}} at {where}.
recap.loggedToday: You logged {count, plural, one {a dive} other {# dives}} today.
recap.hopeWaterTreatedYou: We hope the water treated you well.
recap.tipPaid: Thanks — your tip goes straight to {shop}. They'll make sure the crew hears about it.
recap.tipAllGoes: 100% goes to {shop} — nothing held back, no account needed.
recap.photosBody: Add the shots from today — they stay on your recap, and {shop} may love to see them.
recap.photoLimitReached: You've added the most photos one recap holds. Nice haul!
recap.buddyBody: Diving's better with someone you know. Grab a spot on the next departure and bring them along.

ready.title: Your trip readiness
ready.allSetBody: Your shop is finishing the last checks — there's nothing you need to do right now.
ready.emergencyContactBody: Someone we can reach for you on the day — a name and a phone the crew can call.
ready.moveConfirm: Move your booking to this trip? Your current spot releases as soon as the new one holds.
ready.unavailableBody: Ask your dive shop for a fresh link — nothing here is private to anyone but you.
ready.contactIncomplete: We need both a name and a phone number so the crew can reach someone.
ready.contactTooLong: That name or phone number is too long — try a shorter version.
ready.paymentReceived: Payment received — we're confirming it with your shop. Nothing more to do.
ready.waiverUnavailable: We couldn't open your waiver just now. Try again, or ask the shop for a link.
ready.paymentUnavailable: We couldn't open the payment page. Your seat is safe — try again, or pay at the shop.
ready.paymentCancelled: Payment cancelled — your seat is still held.
ready.cancelUnavailable: We couldn't cancel this online — contact the shop directly.
ready.movedHeading: You're moved! This is your new trip — the old one's released.
ready.moveFailed: That trip couldn't hold you — maybe it just filled up. Try another, or contact the shop.
ready.refundIssued: You paid for this trip, so a refund has been issued back to your card.
ready.refundManual: You paid for this trip. This shop handles cancellation refunds directly — reach out to them about it.
ready.cancelledSeatReleased: Your seat on {trip} is no longer held. If that's a surprise, get in touch with {shop}.
ready.allSetBodyReady: Everything's in order for your trip. Your shop will confirm exact arrival details — we'll see you at the dock.
ready.emergencyOnFile: On file — {name}. Update it below if it's changed.
ready.reschedulePitch: Pick a different trip and we'll move you — your current spot only releases once the new one's confirmed, so you're never left without one.
ready.cancelLead: Cancelling frees your seat right away.
ready.cancelPreviewRefund: You're still inside the free-cancellation window, so what you paid comes back to you.
ready.cancelPreviewForfeit: You're past the free-cancellation window, so what you paid won't be refunded.
ready.cancelPreviewNoPolicy: This shop doesn't automate cancellation refunds, so nothing is refunded right away.
ready.cancelConfirm: Cancel your spot on {trip}? This can't be undone.
ready.questionsSuffix: They can see exactly what's on this page.

waiver.title: Complete your waiver
waiver.unavailableBody: Ask your dive shop for a fresh link.
waiver.expiredBody: Ask your dive shop for a fresh link — no information was submitted.
waiver.incomplete: Please answer every question, type your full name, and confirm your agreement.
waiver.linkInactive: That link is no longer active. Ask the shop for a fresh one.
waiver.medicalReview: Thanks — one of your medical answers needs a closer look, and a doctor's sign-off may be required. Please don't assume you're cleared until your shop confirms.
waiver.signedBody: Signed, saved, and off your mind. We'll see you at the dock — your shop will let you know if anything else is needed.
waiver.seeWhatsLeft: See what's left before you sail
waiver.sitesPeek: Here is a sneak peek at what you will explore on this charter:

rental.heading: Rental fit
rental.ownGear: Bringing own gear — no rental needed.
rental.selectSizes: Select sizes to confirm your gear match.
rental.noCharge: You won't be charged for rentals on this trip.
rental.sizesLocked: The crew has your sizes locked in and ready.
rental.addSizes: Add sizes for all selected items.
rental.whatToPlan: What should we plan to have ready?
rental.askWhatsIncluded: Ask the shop what's included in the trip price.
rental.nitroxOnFile: Your nitrox request is on file.
rental.notSure: Not sure — help me fit it
rental.anythingElse: Anything else the crew should know?

site.landmarksNote: The crew will point out the best approach.

inquiry.whenSuitsHint: Rough is fine — a month or “any weekend” tells us plenty.
